Cyber Attack Disrupts Operations at South Korean Machinery Firms, Including Doosan Enerbility

SEOUL, June 14—A major cyber attack targeting South Korea’s machinery industry has disrupted operations at several leading firms, including Doosan Enerbility Co Ltd, industry officials said on Friday.

The attack, which began late Thursday, involved ransomware infiltrating IT systems and halting key production lines, according to the Korea Machinery Industry Association (KMIA). The full scope of the incident is still emerging, but initial reports indicate that at least four major companies have been affected, with some plants forced to suspend activity as a precaution.

Doosan Enerbility Co Ltd confirmed in a statement that portions of its IT network had been compromised, leading to a temporary shutdown of certain manufacturing processes. “We are working closely with cybersecurity authorities and external experts to contain the situation and restore normal operations as quickly as possible,” the company said.

Namjin Lee, a spokesperson for the KMIA, told reporters, “This is the most significant cyber incident our sector has faced in recent years. Companies are prioritizing safety and data integrity while working to assess the extent of operational disruptions.”

Union representatives at affected firms say the attack has also disrupted administrative systems, complicating employee scheduling and payroll. “We are urging management to ensure workers are kept informed and that safety is not compromised,” said Park Ji-soo, a leader of a local union.

Analysts warn that extended downtime could impact supply chains for heavy equipment and industrial components. “The machinery industry is a cornerstone of South Korea’s manufacturing base. Prolonged outages could have ripple effects on construction and energy projects,” said Jeong Hyeon-woo, a Seoul-based industry analyst.

As of Friday evening, most impacted companies were still working to restore access to encrypted systems. Authorities have not commented on the source of the attack or whether any ransom demands have been made.
